Capacity and dissipation factor. tan (δ)

Testing of sample oil.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Isolate the current 
transformer out of service

Clean the out insulators 
of CT

Measure the insulation 
resistance between primary winding and earth by 2500 volt megger

After isolating secondary 
winding from earth point, make a short on secondary winding leads and measure insulation resistance for 
the secondary winding to 
earth. (for protection & measuring), between primary winding 
and secondary winding

Testing capacity (CX) PF 
and tan (δ).

Measurement of the Internal Insulation

secondary connection.

Disconnect the earthing 
wire from the terminal earth.

Connect this link to the 
bridge for measuring tan (δ)

The disconnection and 
connection of wires connected to and from the leads of the secondaries should be 
carried out under the supervision and agreement of the relay protection engineer 
who are responsible for this work.
The value of tan (δ) should not be more 
than 1.5% at temp.= 20 oC
